metric_definitions.embedding_collapse_score: Mean pairwise cosine of sampled raw ID embeddings, mapped to [0,1]. A value near 0.5 means mean cosine near zero. This does not measure joint title-aware vectors or recommendation diversity. Null if fewer than two real catalog embeddings exist.
metric_definitions.pos_neg_margin_mean: Mean of (pos_logit - neg_logit) over valid positions; higher means clearer separation.
metric_definitions.pos_neg_margin_p10: 10th percentile of (pos_logit - neg_logit); lower suggests many hard/confusing cases.
metric_definitions.pos_neg_neg_beats_pos_rate: Fraction where neg_logit > pos_logit (margin < 0); lower is better.
metric_definitions.pos_neg_small_margin_rate: Fraction where (pos_logit - neg_logit) < eps; higher means weak separation.
metric_definitions.pos_neg_margin_category_breakdown: Category breakdown is unavailable because item categories are not supplied. Valid-position and low/wrong-margin totals describe measured training pairs; empty category lists are not evidence of zero category-specific errors. Null scalar margins mean no valid positions were observed.
